page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical CPU cores with 16 vCPUs, resulting in a configuration of 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server includes a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of total VRAM. It does not contain any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge offers an entry-level GPU-accelerated profile. The inclusion of a dedicated physical core layout without hyperthreading provides predictable compute performance, though the older GPU architecture and lack of local storage represent clear design tradeoffs. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as low-concurrency inference, video transcoding, basic machine learning model evaluation, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated applications that do not require high-throughput local disk I/O or high-speed network bandwidth.
